changelog:
Initial release of ini-align – INI file section and key-value alignment tool.

- Reorders sections and keys in the target INI file to match the order of a source INI file.
- Preserves target-only sections and keys at the end of the output file.
- Lists source-only sections as comments in the output.
- Confirms file paths and prevents accidental overwriting of original files before running.
- Summarizes alignment results, including section counts and duplicate warnings, after execution.
summary: Aligns INI file sections and keys to match a reference file. Target-only content preserved, source-only sections listed as comments.
